temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose notices Patricia seems withdrawn and down compared with her usual vibrant self. When he asks, Patricia says it is personal stuff but does not share details, and she thanks him for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia was usually vibrant and had no specific knowledge of any personal trouble, though he had begun to suspect something might be wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: his suspicion is confirmed enough that he believes Patricia is dealing with personal difficulties, but he does not know what they are.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is likely troubled by something personal, is not ready to disclose it, and appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and cautious relief that she did not reject his support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be available to listen if she wants to talk, without pushing her to share.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worrying about bills and financial commitments. He offers to discuss financial planning and budgeting, and Patricia says she has been overwhelmed by bills and may take him up on it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia had personal troubles but did not know their nature. He believed she appreciated his willingness to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: he now believes Patricia's troubles include concrete financial stress and that she is open to discussing practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially overwhelmed and may accept his help with budgeting or financial planning, though the details remain hers to share.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Deepened concern, sympathy, and a desire to be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer budgeting or financial planning support and wait for her to indicate when she is ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose worries aloud that he may have overstepped by bringing up financial planning. Patricia tells him she did not think he was prying and is grateful for his offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia was financially stressed and had seemed open to his help, but he worried that he might have crossed a boundary.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: his worry is disconfirmed. He now believes Patricia sees his concern as supportive rather than intrusive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his help and does not think he overstepped. He can support her as a friend while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initial worry or anxiety, followed by relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Patricia of his respectful boundaries and continue offering support without prying.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose senses that Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately. In their conversation, she keeps things light, says everything is good, and plans a quiet weekend at home.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia appreciated his support and did not think he had overstepped, while he remained aware of not wanting to intrude.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/confirmed: he now more clearly recognizes that Patricia wants privacy and may prefer normal, low-pressure interactions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates his concern but likely wants to manage her own issues privately; she remains friendly but is not inviting deeper discussion right now.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy, respectful concern, and mild uncertainty about how much to check in.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain a supportive presence without prying, follow her lead, and let her know he is available if needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues checking in with Patricia at work. She says she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia appreciated his concern but preferred privacy and low-pressure contact.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed: Patricia values his supportive presence while managing things independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is busy but coping, appreciates his support, and knows he is available if she needs help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular, low-pressure check-ins and offer practical help, such as coffee, without pushing for details.
